# Required Inline Lesson Images

This is the production brief for inline visuals that appear inside text lessons.

- These are **inline lesson images**, not infographics. Infographics remain separate in the dedicated **Infographics** tab.
- Each concept has an opening visual plus five supporting views. Images should appear beside the exact paragraph they explain.
- Preferred format: WebP, sRGB, no watermark, minimum 1600 px on the long edge.
- Keep important content away from the outer 6% safe area so images crop well on phones, tablets, and TVs.

Total topics: **46**
Total concepts: **484**
Total requested inline images: **2904**
Images per concept: **6**

## Grade 6 and Grade 7 visual sets

Each row below requires the standard six inline files (`inline-01.webp` to `inline-06.webp`) in the concept folder: opening view, concrete example, parts or factors, process, evidence/activity, and misconception comparison.

| Topic name | Subtopic name | Concept name | What image set is needed |
|---|---|---|---|
| Grade 6 Biology | Diversity in the Living World | Diversity Around Us | Local school-garden biodiversity; several real plant and animal forms; grouping by two features; habitat relationships; student observation survey; biodiversity versus number of individuals. |
| Grade 6 Biology | Diversity in the Living World | Herbs, Shrubs and Trees | Accurate mint, rose and mango growth forms; stem close-ups; branching comparison; measurement scene; local examples; young tree versus herb misconception. |
| Grade 6 Biology | Diversity in the Living World | Leaf Venation and Root Types | Reticulate and parallel leaves; exposed taproot and fibrous systems; matched plant pairs; water absorption; safe observation; venation-root comparison. |
| Grade 6 Biology | Diversity in the Living World | Monocot and Dicot Plants | Open bean and maize seeds; one versus two cotyledons; root and venation sets; seedling sequence; observation evidence; matched monocot/dicot comparison. |
| Grade 6 Biology | Diversity in the Living World | Grouping Animals | Cow, bat, pigeon, fish, lizard and insect; body coverings; movement and habitat groups; feature-based sorting; observation table scene; whale/fish misconception. |
| Grade 6 Biology | Diversity in the Living World | Habitats and Adaptations | Duck feet, mountain goat hooves and cactus features; habitat context; form-function close-ups; survival relationship; field evidence; adaptation versus choice. |
| Grade 6 Biology | Diversity in the Living World | Biodiversity and Conservation | Species-rich pond or forest; food-web relationships; habitat loss sequence; biodiversity survey; conservation project; species count versus biodiversity. |
| Grade 6 Biology | Mindful Eating | Food Diversity and Traditions | Diverse regional Indian meal; ingredients and food groups; fermentation/cooking sequence; traditional kitchen; meal comparison; traditional versus automatically healthy misconception. |
| Grade 6 Biology | Mindful Eating | Nutrients in Food | Real foods arranged by main nutrients; carbohydrate/protein/fat sources; micronutrient foods; body uses; label-reading activity; one food versus complete nutrition. |
| Grade 6 Biology | Mindful Eating | Food Tests | Real iodine starch test, translucent fat test and school protein test; controls; correct droppers and samples; result sequence; colour evidence; negative test misconception. |
| Grade 6 Biology | Mindful Eating | Balanced Diet | Affordable balanced Indian plate; food variety; needs by activity; meal-building sequence; one-day diet record; energy-rich versus balanced comparison. |
| Grade 6 Biology | Mindful Eating | Deficiency Diseases | Respectful clinical illustrations of vitamin A, iron, iodine and vitamin D/calcium deficiency; food sources; nutrient-body links; prevention; health evidence; symptom versus diagnosis. |
| Grade 6 Biology | Mindful Eating | Millets and Healthy Grains | Ragi, bajra and jowar plants and grains; millet meal; dry-region field; farm-to-food process; label comparison; millet-only diet misconception. |
| Grade 6 Biology | Mindful Eating | Food Miles | One local and one long-distance food journey; farm, packing, cooling and transport; route comparison; energy inputs; student tracing activity; distance-only footprint misconception. |
| Grade 6 Biology | Living Creatures | Living and Non-living Things | Seedling, dormant seed, wood, stone and toy car; characteristics of life; response and growth sequence; evidence table; observation activity; movement-equals-life misconception. |
| Grade 6 Biology | Living Creatures | Seed Germination | Bean germination stages; water, oxygen and temperature factors; root emergence; controlled jar experiment; recorded results; too-much-water comparison. |
| Grade 6 Biology | Living Creatures | Growth and Movement in Plants | Seedling bending to light and roots turning down; time sequence; light/gravity factors; rotated-pot activity; daily evidence; plant movement versus animal locomotion. |
| Grade 6 Biology | Living Creatures | Plant Life Cycle | Seed-to-seed flowering plant sequence; flower, fruit and seed close-ups; bean life cycle; observation timeline; real garden evidence; growth versus reproduction. |
| Grade 6 Biology | Living Creatures | Mosquito and Frog Life Cycles | Accurate mosquito and frog stages; aquatic versus land stages; metamorphosis sequence; pond habitat; safe observation; tadpole versus adult structures. |
| Grade 6 Biology | Nature's Treasures | Natural Resources | Air, water, soil, forest, sunlight, rocks and fuels in real use; resource-product links; connected landscape; product tracing; local survey; natural resource versus manufactured object. |
| Grade 6 Biology | Nature's Treasures | Air and Water as Resources | Respiration, photosynthesis, aquatic habitat, wind and water use; rainwater harvesting; clean/polluted comparison; school audit; cycle evidence; renewable versus unlimited. |
| Grade 6 Biology | Nature's Treasures | Forests, Soil and Minerals | Forest floor, roots holding soil, soil profile, rocks and mineral products; erosion sequence; field comparison; mining context; evidence after rain; soil versus dirt misconception. |
| Grade 6 Biology | Nature's Treasures | Renewable and Non-renewable Resources | Solar, wind, forest, groundwater, coal and petroleum; formation/replacement times; matched energy uses; recharge sequence; evidence graph; renewable versus inexhaustible. |
| Grade 6 Biology | Nature's Treasures | Conserving Natural Resources | Water repair, reuse, efficient energy and habitat protection; waste hierarchy; school resource audit; before/after evidence; community action; recycling versus preventing waste. |
| Grade 7 Biology | Adolescence | Adolescence and Puberty | Respectful diverse adolescents; growth timeline without idealised bodies; puberty versus adolescence; healthy variation; age-range evidence; early/late timing misconception. |
| Grade 7 Biology | Adolescence | Physical Changes During Adolescence | Age-appropriate body-change diagrams; skin and sweat glands; secondary sexual characteristics; growth sequence; common versus sex-typical changes; respectful variation. |
| Grade 7 Biology | Adolescence | Menstruation | Age-appropriate uterus cycle diagram; menstrual products and hygiene; lining change sequence; cycle calendar with variation; health-support scene; menstruation-as-illness misconception. |
| Grade 7 Biology | Adolescence | Emotional Changes in Adolescence | Respectful everyday emotional situations; brain, hormones and environment factors; coping sequence; trusted-support network; wellbeing journal; feeling versus harmful action. |
| Grade 7 Biology | Adolescence | Healthy Adolescence | Balanced meal, sleep, movement, hygiene and supportive relationships; daily routine; nutrient needs; healthy choices; habit tracker; extreme diet versus balanced health. |
| Grade 7 Biology | Adolescence | Hormones During Puberty | Gland-to-blood-to-target pathway; pituitary, thyroid, testes and ovaries at suitable educational detail; receptor concept; puberty response; evidence diagram; hormone versus organ. |
| Grade 7 Biology | Adolescence | Avoiding Addictive Substances | Age-appropriate refusal and support scenario; tobacco effects on lungs; peer-pressure pathway; help-seeking; prevention evidence; addiction versus moral failure misconception. |
| Grade 7 Biology | Life Processes in Animals | Life Processes | Digestive, respiratory and circulatory systems linked to cells; matter-flow sequence; organ-system cooperation; energy and waste pathway; body evidence; reproduction versus individual survival. |
| Grade 7 Biology | Life Processes in Animals | Human Digestive System | Accurate labelled alimentary canal and associated organs; organ close-ups; food journey; peristalsis; model activity; digestion versus food passage. |
| Grade 7 Biology | Life Processes in Animals | Digestion and Absorption | Enzyme breakdown, small-intestine villi and nutrient entry to blood; saliva-starch activity; sequence; surface-area view; evidence results; digestion versus absorption versus assimilation. |
| Grade 7 Biology | Life Processes in Animals | Digestion in Other Animals | Ruminant cud pathway and Amoeba food vacuole; feeding structures; comparison; process sequence; microscopy evidence; human-style digestion misconception. |
| Grade 7 Biology | Life Processes in Animals | Breathing and Respiration | Chest ventilation and cellular glucose breakdown shown separately; exercise connection; equation components; breathing-rate activity; gas evidence; breathing-equals-respiration misconception. |
| Grade 7 Biology | Life Processes in Animals | Human Respiratory System | Accurate nostrils-to-alveoli pathway; diaphragm positions; rib cage and lungs; inhale/exhale sequence; safe model; lungs as empty balloons misconception. |
| Grade 7 Biology | Life Processes in Animals | Alveoli and Gas Exchange | Microscopic alveoli-capillary view; oxygen and carbon-dioxide gradients; thin moist surface; limewater activity; healthy/damaged comparison; air versus pure oxygen. |
| Grade 7 Biology | Life Processes in Animals | Circulatory System | Heart, blood vessels and tissue capillaries; nutrient/oxygen/waste routes; pulse; circulation sequence; simple route model; artery/vein oxygen misconception. |
| Grade 7 Biology | Life Processes in Animals | Breathing in Other Animals | Fish gills, insect tracheae, earthworm skin, tadpole gills and adult frog lungs/skin; habitat comparison; gas path; observation evidence; all animals use lungs misconception. |
| Grade 7 Biology | Life Processes in Plants | Photosynthesis | Real leaf in sunlight plus chloroplast context; carbon dioxide/water/glucose/oxygen pathway; potato starch; aquatic oxygen bubbles; starch experiment; plants-get-food-from-soil misconception. |
| Grade 7 Biology | Life Processes in Plants | Leaves and Stomata | Leaf cross-section and real stomata micrograph; broad/thin structure; guard cells; gas and water movement; peel activity; stomata as fixed holes misconception. |
| Grade 7 Biology | Life Processes in Plants | Requirements for Photosynthesis | Controlled light, chlorophyll, carbon dioxide and water tests; destarched plant; iodine sequence; experimental controls; results; starch test versus direct photosynthesis proof. |
| Grade 7 Biology | Life Processes in Plants | Xylem Transport | Roots, xylem vessels and leaf pathway; coloured celery/flower activity; transpiration pull; warm/cool comparison; real vessel view; xylem versus whole stem. |
| Grade 7 Biology | Life Processes in Plants | Phloem Transport | Leaf source to fruit/root/young shoot sinks; phloem tissue; upward and downward flow; girdling evidence at safe diagram level; xylem/phloem comparison. |
| Grade 7 Biology | Life Processes in Plants | Respiration in Plants | Germinating seeds and limewater; glucose-oxygen process in plant cells; day/night relationship; root oxygen; experimental evidence; respiration versus photosynthesis. |

## Required filenames inside every concept folder

- `inline-01.webp` - opening hero visual
- `inline-02.webp` - first concept-specific supporting view
- `inline-03.webp` - second concept-specific supporting view
- `inline-04.webp` - third concept-specific supporting view
- `inline-05.webp` - fourth concept-specific supporting view
- `inline-06.webp` - fifth concept-specific supporting view

Infographics use their own `infographic-01.webp` path and are intentionally excluded from this inline-image list.
